item.description: Grönland Records announce ERR: A photographic essay by David Sylvian, with text by Shinya Fujiwara and an original poem by Daisy Lafarge, ‘a road is a shape of devotion’. A limited edition publication: 500 copies signed and numbered by the artist. 50 signed, unnumbered copies randomly distributed among the remaining edition. Publication date: 19 November 2021. Art direction: David Sylvian. Assistant art direction: Yuka Fujii. Graphic design and typography: Giles Dunn for Punkt, London. Size: 235

item.title: Junya Watanabe FW22 Collection
item.description: The Sylvian/Czukay composition “Plight (The Spiralling Of Winter Ghosts)” was the inspiration for Japanese fashion designer Junya Watanabe’s Fall/Winter 2022 collection. item.title: ‘Blemish’ and ‘Manafon’ – 180gram vinyl reissues available to preorder
item.description: samadhisound and UMC are proud to announce 180gram vinyl reissues of David Sylvian’s Blemish and Manafon albums, releasing on 2nd September 2022 and available to preorder now. Vinyl versions of both records have been out of print since their very limited initial pressing in the early 2000s. These new versions of Blemish (1LP) and Manafon (2LP) have been recut for vinyl by veteran engineer Tony Cousins at Metropolis studios. item.description: In celebration of composer Ryuichi Sakamoto’s 70th birthday, Milan Records presents A Tribute to Ryuichi Sakamoto - To the Moon and Back, a collection of songs from Sakamoto’s vast catalogue newly reworked and remodelled by contemporary artists and collaborators.
